name: card-mafia
description: Plan award flights with Indian premium credit cards: which card, which transfer path, which seat.
long_description: Card Mafia turns a trip goal into a checked award-flight plan for Indian premium cardholders. Ask Claude where you want to go and which cards you hold. It builds the cheapest points paths with ratios, caps and seat age checked before any transfer, searches award seats, runs the points calculator, ranks cards by what a month of spending earns, and points you to the airline's own booking page. Nothing is booked, transferred or stored. Seat data is cached and every result shows its age; always confirm on your bank and airline sites before moving points.
